description.text:
An enhanced expansion pack of the Scarlet & Violet series, released on 16 June 2023 in packs of seven cards. It holds the Pokémon of the first games, Bulbasaur to Mew in Pokédex order, with Trainers from Kanto such as Giovanni's Charisma, Erika's Invitation and Bill's Transfer, and the old fossils as Items that can be played as Basic Pokémon. Its cards are numbered to 165, with secret rares up to 210, and some also come in a mirror finish with a Poké Ball pattern.

The set brought back Kadabra, left out of the card game since 2002 after Uri Geller sued over it; Geller himself announced its return in January 2023. Demand ran high, and Pokémon Center Online took orders for boxes made to order from 15 to 21 June. The English Scarlet & Violet—151 (September 2023) has the same 165 numbered cards.
